candidate.answerReason: All five tip triangles have fixed angles and are similar. Their total contribution to the star perimeter is therefore a fixed multiple of the pentagon's perimeter, so s is constant.

methods.label: Sum the contributions of the five tips
methods.explanation:
Although the pentagon's side lengths may vary, its angles cannot. Their sum is \(540^\circ\), so each interior angle is \(108^\circ\).

For example, extend \(EA\) past \(A\) and \(CB\) past \(B\) until they meet at the star tip opposite side \(AB\). The triangle formed with base \(AB\) has both base angles equal to
\[
180^\circ-108^\circ=72^\circ,
\]
and hence tip angle \(36^\circ\). The same argument applies to every pentagon side. Thus all five tip triangles have angles \(72^\circ,72^\circ,36^\circ\) and are similar.

Let \(r\) be the sum of the two nonbase side lengths divided by the base length in one tip triangle. Similarity makes this ratio the same for all five triangles. Their ten nonbase sides therefore have total length
\[
r(AB+BC+CD+DE+EA)=r,
\]
because the pentagon has perimeter \(1\).

Each of the star polygon's five long sides consists of one pentagon side together with an extension at each end. Altogether, these pieces count the five pentagon sides once and the ten nonbase sides of the tip triangles once. Consequently,
\[
s=1+r.
\]
The ratio \(r\) depends only on the fixed triangle angles, so every allowed pentagon produces the same \(s\). Its maximum and minimum are equal, and their difference is \(\boxed{0}\), choice \(\boxed{\text{A}}\).

candidate.annotationRationale: The target is using corresponding-length ratios in similar triangles to prove a perimeter is constant. Polygon and triangle angle sums establish the fixed tip angles, and AA establishes similarity. No equality of pentagon side lengths is assumed.

review.mathematicalCheck: Every exterior tip triangle has angles 72,72,36 degrees, so its nonbase-length sum has a fixed ratio r to its base. Summing the five long star sides counts the pentagon perimeter once and all ten tip legs once, giving s=1+r and difference 0.
